name: Nedabja
title: Descendant of King David
summary: Nedabja was a descendant of King David through the line of Zerubbabel. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as part of the royal lineage after the exile. His significance lies in being a link in the Davidic line that was preserved through the Babylonian captivity.

keyEvents.title: Recorded in David's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Nedabja is mentioned as one of Zerubbabel's sons in the royal genealogical record in 1 Chronicles, which preserved the Davidic lineage.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Post-Exilic Lineage
keyEvents.description: As a descendant of David through Zerubbabel, Nedabja represents the continuation of the royal promise given to David's house, even after the Babylonian exile.

keyEvents.title: Zerubbabel's Sons Listed
keyEvents.description: Nedabja is part of the list of Zerubbabel's children, showing that the Davidic line continued to be carefully recorded after the return from Babylon.

keyEvents.title: David's Royal Promise Continued
keyEvents.description: Through the lineage that includes Nedabja, God's promise to David of an eternal throne was preserved—a promise that pointed toward the coming Messiah.
